result: Delivers keep-going-across-reloads. claimAutoRun refuses to re-arm a job whose execution reported COMPLETED, so a run that claims a completion it has not earned does not merely stop - it permanently disables the reload-resume, which is exactly why reloading did nothing. Added Applicants.isConclusiveListStop(): only settled and pagination-retired may complete a run; grow-budget, no-list, pagination-refused and list-exhausted are retried up to MAX_INCONCLUSIVE_GROWTHS (3), reset by any growth that produces a row, and exhausting them ends the run as STOPPED, which reaches the worker as INTERRUPTED and stays restartable. growApplicantList clears walk.stoppedBy at the start of each call because the shared ledger made that verdict sticky and it is now read twice. This restores the behaviour of TASK-0069, which the user rolled back believing it broke resume downloads; that was afterwards shown to be impossible - TASK-0069 touched only the completion policy, never extractApplicant, the section scan or chrome.downloads.
